periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, approximately 45 degrees downward toward the rostrum relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval, with the vertical-oblique axis substantially longer than the horizontal-oblique axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering, with the lowermost point of the patch extending significantly below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Deep U-shape curvature along the posterior edge of the scapular band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad band spanning approximately one-third of the visible lateral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, roughly twice the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex circular arcs with no visible flattening or irregularities.

other_distinctive_markers: Noticeable chromatic shift to a brownish-buff hue on the hindquarters and lower flanks compared to the white cranial fur.
